verdict.rationale: Retell explicitly documents a 'press digit' tool for DTMF keypresses to navigate IVR menus during outbound calls (retell-docs-65), backed by broader function-calling capabilities (retell-docs-5, retell-docs-35). However, no evidence in the pack documents voicemail detection or leaving a voicemail message as a built-in agent capability. missing for 10: voicemail detection/leaving feature documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of DTMF/IVR navigation working in practice.
